name: Hydroponics Unit
description: Grow beds, nutrient feeds and grow-lights. Produces food and helps scrub CO2.

name: Sleeping Quarters
description: Bunks, lockers and sconce lighting. Raises crew rest quality and morale.

name: Research Lab
description: Ancient database taps and analysis benches. Unlocks tech and translation progress.

name: Machine Shop
description: Fabricators and tool benches. Converts salvage into Ship Parts for repairs.

name: Infirmary Ward
description: Med beds and diagnostic consoles. Speeds crew recovery from injury.

name: Storage Depot
description: Crates, racks and barrels. Raises the ship-wide resource stockpile cap.
